timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,513.6 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently weak at 1,513.6 KRW per dollar, making dollars expensive for your monthly conversion. News indicates expectations for the won to strengthen back to the 1,400s range within this month, suggesting the current level is elevated and unfavorable for dollar purchases.

TIP: Consider waiting a few days or weeks if possible, since market sentiment points to near-term won strengthening that would lower your conversion cost; if you must buy monthly regardless, dollar-cost averaging smooths out timing risk over time.
